notes.subject: ⟨हइ⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no verb in the final clause — 'there is a judgment' needs a copula in Magahi

notes.subject: גורו
notes.rationale: root גור here either 'dwell/turn aside' or 'fear'; KJV/JPS take 'be afraid', literally 'turn aside for yourselves'

notes.subject: חמה עונות חרב
notes.rationale: 'wrath — iniquities — sword' with no verb; renderings range from 'wrath brings the punishments of the sword' (KJV) to 'the sword is the avenger of iniquities' (Wycliffe)

notes.subject: חרב...חרב
notes.rationale: חרב appears twice framing חמה עונות; repetition lost in Magahi

notes.subject: तोहनी सब
notes.rationale: Job addresses his three friends directly with a warning

translation: तलवार के आगू तोहनी सब डरऽ — काहे कि गुस्सा तलवार के पाप के ⟨तलवार⟩ हकइ — एकरा बर जे तोहनी जानऽ कि नियाव ⟨हइ⟩।
